001package org.clafer.ast.analysis;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import java.util.Collection;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Map;
008import org.clafer.ast.AstAbstractClafer;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
010import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
011import org.clafer.ast.AstException;
012import org.clafer.ast.AstUtil;
013import org.clafer.collection.Pair;
014
015/**
016 *
017 * @author jimmy
018 */
019public class InsufficientScopeException extends AstException {
020
021    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
022
023    private final Pair<AstClafer, Integer>[] insufficientScopes;
024
025    public InsufficientScopeException(Pair<AstClafer, Integer>[] insufficientScopes) {
026        this(false, merge(Arrays.asList(insufficientScopes)));
027    }
028
029    public InsufficientScopeException(Collection<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>> insufficientScopes) {
030        this(false, merge(insufficientScopes));
031    }
032
033    private InsufficientScopeException(boolean flag,
034            Pair<AstClafer, Integer>[] insufficientScopes) {
035        super(message(insufficientScopes));
036        if (insufficientScopes.length == 0) {
037            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
038        }
039        this.insufficientScopes = insufficientScopes.clone();
040    }
041
042    private static Pair<AstClafer, Integer>[] merge(
043            Iterable<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>> insufficientScopes) {
044        Map<AstClafer, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
045        for (Pair<AstClafer, Integer> insufficientScope : insufficientScopes) {
046            Integer value = map.get(insufficientScope.getFst());
047            if (value == null || value < insufficientScope.getSnd()) {
048                map.put(insufficientScope.getFst(), insufficientScope.getSnd());
049            }
050        }
051        return Pair.toPairs(map);
052    }
053
054    private static String message(Pair<AstClafer, Integer>[] insufficientScopes) {
055        StringBuilder message = new StringBuilder();
056        message.append("The provided scope is too low, consider increasing the following scopes:\n\n");
057        for (Pair<AstClafer, Integer> insufficientScope : insufficientScopes) {
058            message.append("    ").append(insufficientScope.getFst())
059                    .append(" to at least ").append(insufficientScope.getSnd());
060            if (insufficientScope.getFst() instanceof AstAbstractClafer) {
061                List<AstConcreteClafer> subs = AstUtil.getConcreteSubs(insufficientScope.getFst());
062                if (subs.isEmpty()) {
063                    message.append(" (no concrete subclafers)");
064                } else {
065                    message.append(" (concrete subclafers are ");
066                    message.append(subs);
067                    message.append(')');
068                }
069            }
070            message.append('\n');
071        }
072        return message.toString();
073    }
074
075    public Pair<AstClafer, Integer>[] getInsufficientScopes() {
076        return insufficientScopes;
077    }
078}
